description: Look up a list of package names on one package registry and return one row per name, in the order given, so the health of a project's dependencies can be read in one call. ecosystem is the package registry the names belong to and accepts only the package registries this catalog admits, currently npm; any other value is refused as an invalid argument and the refusal names the accepted values. packages lists 1 to 100 names. A list of more than 100 names is refused as an invalid argument and is never cut short. Each name must be a well-formed npm package name, such as commander or @scope/name; a malformed name is refused as an invalid argument that names its position in the list, and nothing is looked up. A name given more than once returns one row, at its first position. The request as a whole is limited to 8192 bytes, and a larger request is refused with an error that names the limit. Each name resolves as get_project resolves registry and package: only a package bound to a repository both ways resolves, and a package bound to more than one project does not. A project below the discovery floor that search does not return still resolves. A row for a name that resolves has status matched and a project object: the repository host, numeric id and slug, the project page URL, the claim state, the five health-signal bands, each with its status, source and fetch date, and the signals_unavailable and stale flags. Every other row has status not_in_catalog and carries only the name, whatever the reason the name did not resolve. Rows are never sorted by health, and the response carries no score, rank, total or person-derived count. The names are used only to answer the call: this server does not store or log them, and its usage analytics record the registry and how many names a call gave and matched, never a name. Health signals are reported as bands, not raw measures. What each band means, and its cut-point, is published on the catalog's methodology page (/methodology). Read-only. Serves catalog schema v1.

ecosystem.description: The package registry the names belong to. Only the registries this catalog admits are accepted.

packages.description: 1 to 100 package names on ecosystem, e.g. "express" or "@scope/name". A name given more than once returns one row.

name: check_dependencies
